nodes.label: Brought sprites folder
nodes.rationale: One tree for user-supplied or third-party art, subfoldered by mod, so brought files do not scatter into temp folders or loose mod roots.

nodes.label: No generation reference rule for brought art
nodes.rationale: Agents must not use these files as GenerateImage reference_image_paths or as a 'match this style' basis; only verbatim copying into a mod Textures path is allowed, keeping third-party art placement separate from generation.
